summary: Python 3.4 added the asyncio module for asynchronous I/O (PEP 3156), the pathlib module for object-oriented path handling, the enum module, and ensurepip to bootstrap pip in fresh installs. The statistics module was added. .pyo files were removed; .pyc represents both optimized and unoptimized bytecode. This release established the asyncio ecosystem.
notes: Unsupported since 2019-03-18. Last micro 3.4.10. Full support ended 2017-08-09. asyncio became the foundation for async frameworks like aiohttp and FastAPI.
